Test Automation Development in JS ecosystem

Description
Strengthen JS/TS ecosystem knowledge and TAF reliability.

Recommended actions:

- Review npm versioning and dependency management:
   - Semantic versioning: major/minor/patch
   - Difference between ^, ~, and exact versions
   - package-lock.json
   - npm install vs npm ci
   - Pinning package versions
   - Dependency update strategy
   - Use of overrides where applicable

- Review TypeScript vs JavaScript differences:
   - Static typing vs runtime behavior
   - Type inference
   - Interfaces vs types
   - Generics
   - Transpilation
   - tsconfig configuration
   - Runtime limitations of TypeScript

- Revisit SOLID principles, especially:
   - LSP - Liskov Substitution Principle
   - ISP - Interface Segregation Principle
   - DIP - Dependency Inversion Principle
- Apply these principles to test automation framework examples:
   - Page objects/components
   - API clients
   - Fixtures
   - Test data builders
   - Reporting adapters
